shapeEntries.rationale: Legacy pre-2012 single-origin form (LegacyS3Origin definition), sibling of CustomOrigin; superseded by Origins[] and absent from the modern CreateDistribution/UpdateDistribution API. The StreamingDistribution API still has a same-spelled S3Origin member, which is why the definition pass (issue #1378) reports it.
